node: Tungsten APT intermediate processing and WF6 semiconductor gas
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the tungsten APT/WF6 chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. Air Products is the obvious WF6 reference anchor. The underfollowed lane is more interesting: Kennametal as a tungsten-carbide tooling and powder user/producer exposed to APT cost and availability; United States Antimony as a small-cap critical-minerals company with a newly disclosed Fostung tungsten project but not yet proven APT/WF6 exposure; and American Resources as a speculative shadow candidate through its minority-linked ReElement tungsten purification milestone. The key distinction for later layers is actual intermediate processing capacity versus mining optionality or lab-scale purification claims.
